subject: Re: Kickoff: Didi digital-ink benchmark hosting
body:
Decisions to close out the half:

1. Amara's proposal is approved: the 4% alignment-noisy subset is excluded from the headline metric but published as a separate diagnostic split. Transparent and defensible.
2. Scoring rules freeze this Friday, May 1. Chiara, please version them in the service so a rule change can never silently reshuffle historical entries.
3. The leaderboard service opens to internal submissions May 8 with Katya's 71.8% baseline as entry #1. Demo at the data-platforms all-hands the following week.

Nice execution on a tight window, everyone. This gives the diagram-understanding work a real yardstick going into Q3.

Dmitri
